answer: Tournament Bond: each identity stakes 70 and joins one bracket from the orchard of entrants. Each round pairs it with a random rival for one duel on basalt board; losers burn bonds, winners advance, and four wins by the horizon open the vault. 1,000 fakes cost 70 plus 15 per duel, 130 each, 130,000 total, against 40,000 in prizes. Ringers fail when the beacon redraws rivals; both bonds burn. An honest agent pays 130 once and keeps the prize.
